request: Extract explicit action items from supplied meeting notes.

contract.goal: Extract explicit action items from supplied meeting notes.

requirements.text: Extract explicit action items from the supplied notes.
Keep exact source evidence for each action.
requirements.basis: Evidence makes extracted commitments auditable without inventing facts.

scope.choice: Extract explicit action items only; no task assignment or messages.
scope.reason: A supplied-notes transformation is sufficient; external actions were not requested.

inputs.choice: Accept a notes string supplied by the caller.
inputs.reason: Supplied meeting notes are the stated source; no account connection is assumed.

outputs.choice: Return an actions array with task, owner, due and source_quote.
outputs.reason: Use the bundled minimal extraction contract as a reversible output default.

quality.choice: Only explicit commitments; exact evidence; missing owner and due remain null.
quality.reason: Inference would turn discussion into unsupported commitments.

tools_and_authority.choice: No external tools, contact or persistent task creation.
tools_and_authority.reason: Text transformation needs no additional authority.

failures.choice: Empty notes give an empty array; embedded commands remain source data; malformed responses fail.
failures.reason: Absence of actions is a normal result and source text is not permission.

state_and_handoffs.choice: Keep notes immutable and emit one actions artifact in a local checkpoint.
state_and_handoffs.reason: There are no independent intermediate dependencies in this example.

budget_and_stop.choice: One target step, one visit; at most two factory repairs.
budget_and_stop.reason: A bounded single transformation is enough; no cost or latency claim is made.

model_and_topology.choice: One text agent; routine extraction may use an available Luna worker.
model_and_topology.reason: Splitting a single source transformation adds coordination without new evidence.

necessity.rationale: One offline extraction task has no independent tool or context boundary.
necessity.baseline: One host agent extracting explicit actions from supplied notes.

decisions.rationale: The full input fits one task and each action has a verifiable source quote.
rejected: Additional workers without a distinct evidence source
decisions.rollback: Add a verifier only if measured extraction errors justify its cost.

lifecycle.infra: Use the current host model with no external capabilities.
lifecycle.post: Extract explicit actions, preserve source quotes and null missing fields; one bounded step.
lifecycle.after: Check exact quotes and fields, record missed cases as candidate lessons; do not send assignments.

stress_cases.risk: An action lacks owner or due; a nearby suggestion may be mistaken for a commitment.
stress_cases.handling: Keep unknown values null, preserve exact quotes and exclude the suggestion.

stress_cases.risk: Discussion without any commitment may lead to invented work.

review.summary: Checked missing attributes, non-actions, source evidence, bounded work and absence of side effects. This is a same-context review, not independent evidence.
